title: Waiting in the wrong place
hints: The workers send on results, which is unbuffered. Nobody receives until wg.Wait() returns, but wg.Wait() can't return until the workers finish sending. That's a deadlock.
Receive results while the workers are still running. Close results once they're all done, from a separate goroutine that does wg.Wait() and then close(results).
go func() { wg.Wait(); close(results) }(); for r := range results { out[r.word] = r.n }
